trigger: Webhook from POST /api/admin/staff when a new staff member is created
description: Automates the full staff setup flow: creates their Google Sheet, sends Discord welcome DM, posts in team channel. Replaces manual setup steps.

payload.name: string — full name (e.g. 'Kian Ahmad')
payload.role: string — dm_setter | setter | closer | coach | admin | owner
payload.loginUrl: string — URL to the login page

makeSteps: 2. Google Sheets: Copy template sheet (GOOGLE_SHEETS_TEMPLATE_ID) → rename to '{name} KPI Tracker'
3. Google Sheets: Get the new sheet's ID
4. HTTP PATCH: POST https://stack-n-scale.vercel.app/api/admin/staff with { id: staffId, sheetId: newSheetId, token: CRON_SECRET } to save Sheet ID back to staff record
YES → Discord: Send DM to discordId:

'👋 Welcome to Stack-N-Scale! Here are your login details:
🔗 Login: {loginUrl}
📊 Your KPI sheet has been created.
📌 Check #team-general for next steps.'
NO → Skip Discord DM (no Discord ID on file)
'🎉 Welcome {name} to the team as {role}! @everyone give them a warm welcome.'
7. Optional: Google Drive — create a folder under Staff/ named '{name}'
requiredEnvVars: GOOGLE_SHEETS_TEMPLATE_ID — ID of the KPI tracker template sheet to copy
DISCORD_TEAM_GENERAL_CHANNEL_ID — Channel to post welcome messages
notes: Step 4 (saving sheetId back) requires the staff PATCH endpoint to accept Bearer token auth (CRON_SECRET) so Make.com can call it without a browser session
If discordId is blank, the DM step is skipped — add Discord ID via admin panel later to send manually
This scenario replaces 4 manual steps: create sheet, share sheet, DM login, post in team channel
